text:
Anna M: Heads-up: proposing we change tenant identifier in analytics from composite string (tenant_uuid) to compact numeric id (tenant_id_int) to speed queries and reduce index bloat. Starting a small canary cutover plan. /cc @Matt @Lia
Matt: What's the UI impact? dashboards query by tenant_uuid today...
Anna M: The console will keep querying tenant_uuid for now; we'll add a read adapter that maps uuid->int using a small mapping table. Canaries will dual-write both columns for 1 week.
Lia: Dual-write sounds reasonable. Concern: timebucket aggregations + rollups getting inconsistent during backfill.
Anna M: Backfill plan: batched jobs per tenant windowed by day, throttle at 50 tps. SQL:
```
UPDATE analytics.metrics
SET tenant_id_int = mapping.id
FROM tenant_map mapping
WHERE metrics.tenant_uuid = mapping.tenant_uuid
AND tenant_id_int IS NULL;
```
Matt: How long for ~1B rows? estimate?
Anna M: ~10 hours with chunking; we'll pause on p99 spike, verify counts on held-out checks.
SRE-bot: canary job started 1745556701 (job-id: canary-metrics-uuid-swap)
David: Router note: routing currently hashes tenant_uuid. We'll add a shim that normalizes to tenant_id_int for shard selection but fallbacks to uuid on mapping miss.
Lia: Console fallback: add feature-flagged query path so dashboards query legacy path if tenant not migrated.
Anna M: Rollout plan: 1) dual-write, 2) read-adapter, 3) backfill, 4) soft switch (flag per tenant), 5) stop writing tenant_uuid. Target 3-week window.
Matt: Add regression alert for dashboard p90 latency and missing series. Link eval prompts / run dashboards smoke tests.
Lia: Security: mapping table is sensitive. Restrict to infra role, encrypt at rest, audit reads.
Anna M: Agree. Also log mapping lookup failures and expose metrics for mapping-miss-rate.
David: Update quota calcs: quota bucketing unchanged but indexing cost improves. Need to patch quota service to accept tenant_id_int in incoming envelope.
Matt: Who owns preflight checks? @Anna run staging canary; @David handle router shim; @Lia add dashboard fallback flag.
Anna M: I'll kick off staging tomorrow and drop the canary metrics here. :thumbsup:
SRE-bot: canary job completed 1745556780 — no regressions found in staging
Lia: Ok ready to start prod canary next week. :eyes:
Matt: Schedule on low-traffic window, ping infra.
Anna M: Thanks all — will follow up with playbook and runbook links.
